type.name: IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5
type.description: A server adapter capable of controlling and deploying to a WebSphere Application Server 8.5 (traditional) profile via wsadmin.

type.name: IBM WebSphere Application Server 9.0
type.description: A server adapter capable of controlling and deploying to a WebSphere Application Server 9.0 (traditional) profile via wsadmin.

server.home.dir.description: Filesystem path to the WAS *profile* home (contains bin/startServer.sh, bin/stopServer.sh, bin/wsadmin.sh). Example: /opt/IBM/WebSphere/AppServer/profiles/AppSrv01

was.server.name.description: The application server name inside the profile, e.g. server1

was.node.name.description: Node name. Only needed to disambiguate targeting on ND cells.

was.cell.name.description: Cell name. Informational only for this MVP; not used for Base profiles.

was.host.description: Host wsadmin and the HTTP poller connect to.

was.soap.port.description: SOAP connector port used by wsadmin to administer this server.

was.http.port.description: HTTP transport port used to poll whether the server is up.

was.admin.user.description: Admin console / wsadmin user. Leave blank if administrative security is disabled.

was.admin.password.description: Admin console / wsadmin password. Leave blank if administrative security is disabled.

was.wsadmin.lang.description: Scripting language passed to wsadmin via -lang.

was.poll.timeout.seconds.description: How many seconds to wait for the server to report up/down before giving up.

was.debug.port.description: JDWP port the server's JVM listens on when started in "debug" mode.

was.admin.console.port.description: HTTP port of the WAS admin console (used by the "Open Admin Console" action).
